name: Coil Tec of Arizona Inc
old_description: Committed to producing the highest Quality magnetic components since 1989.
about:
Coil Tec of Arizona Inc operates from a 35,000-square-foot facility in Phoenix, Arizona. The company was founded in 1989 and has focused on magnetic components since its inception. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures transformers, inductors, and coils using cellular manufacturing techniques. Each production cell performs 100% testing of parts, and a quality team samples output under a zero-defect plan. The facility's layout and low overhead are cited as enabling competitive pricing.

Coil Tec serves customers requiring magnetic components, though specific industries or customer types are not detailed in its public materials. The company maintains a finished-goods inventory to support on-time delivery.

Coil Tec emphasizes its cellular manufacturing approach as a differentiator, claiming it provides the most predictable outcomes of any manufacturing method. The company also highlights its finished-goods inventory for on-time delivery and low overhead for competitive pricing.
type_evidence: All products are manufactured in our modern 35,000 sq. ft. facility located in Phoenix, Arizona.
